metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2003 · The Pianist
metas.description: During WWII, acclaimed Polish musician Wladyslaw faces various struggles as he loses contact with his family. As the situation worsens, he hides in the ruins of Warsaw in order to survive.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1978 · Autumn Sonata
metas.description: A devoted wife is visited by her mother, a successful concert pianist who had little time for her when she was young.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1998 · The Legend of 1900
metas.description: A baby boy discovered on an ocean liner in 1900 grows into a musical prodigy, never setting foot on land.
